verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic documents that it speaks named commerce protocols, ACP and UCP, for agent checkout flows, and Adyen publishes its API definitions publicly as OpenAPI files on GitHub that anyone can load into Swagger tooling. The pack never states that ACP or UCP are open, versioned specifications that can be read and implemented without an agreement, and it does not show that the agentic APIs are in the public OpenAPI repo. Probes for a hosted OpenAPI file all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence that ACP/UCP are openly published and versioned, confirmation that no signup or agreement is needed to read and implement them, and coverage of the agentic cart/feed APIs in the public OpenAPI definitions.
